summary: ITER147 · International Profile Identity™ — VERIFIED end-to-end against REAL ALE/Claude. Backend pytest 27/27 PASS (test_iter147 + iter146 core safety + iter146 lead pipeline). Live E2E 6/7 PASS — cultural adaptation via the REAL Emergent LLM key works PERFECTLY for all four target locales (en-us 'Founder & Creative Director', fr-fr 'Fondateur & Directeur Artistique', de-de 'Inhaber & Kreativdirektor', es-es 'Fundador y Director Creativo'). Manual override survives source re-patch, regenerate produces fresh ALE output, restore-ale drops manual back to auto, lock blocks regenerate with HTTP 409, resolve_for_locale returns localized values for known locales and falls back to source (Italian) for unknown locales. Frontend OwnerIntroductionModal opens via the 'mfd:open-owner-introduction' custom event, the 'VERSIONI INTERNAZIONALI™ · OPZIONALE' details block is present (data-testid='intl-versions-toggle'), expanding it reveals the InternationalVersionsPanel with all 4 locale cards (testids intl-locale-card-en-us / -fr-fr / -de-de / -es-es), each showing flag + market name + editorial badge 'Adattata per il pubblico locale' + the localized ALE value + edit/regen/lock actions. NO forbidden brand phrases ('AI', 'AI generated', 'machine translated', 'Macchina', 'Generato da', 'tradotto') appear in the panel. ONE BUG FOUND: GET /api/profile/me/identity does NOT report status='locked' for locked rows — it returns status='auto' even though the locked boolean is persisted and POST /regenerate correctly returns 409. This breaks the frontend lock-badge and disabled-regenerate UX.

critical.issue: Status taxonomy does not report `locked` — locked rows return status='auto'. DB `locked=true` persists correctly and POST .../regenerate returns 409, but `get_identity()` ignores the locked column when building the per-locale status. Concrete repro: POST /api/profile/me/identity/role_label/en-US/lock?locked=true → 200 with result={'locked': true}; immediately GET /api/profile/me/identity returns en-us locale row with status='auto' (expected 'locked'). Fix likely lives in services/profile_identity_resolver.py — the locale row builder needs to check the editorial_block_translations.locked column and emit status='locked' before falling through to the underlying translation status.

ui_bugs.issue: Because backend GET /identity reports status='auto' for locked locales (see backend critical bug), the lock badge 'Approvata · bloccata' never renders and the regenerate button is not disabled — the UI cannot distinguish a locked locale from an auto one. This is a downstream effect of the backend bug above; fixing the backend status mapper will resolve it.

action_items: FIX backend: services/profile_identity_resolver.py get_identity() — when building each locale row, check editorial_block_translations.locked and emit status='locked' BEFORE returning the row's normal status. Without this fix the frontend cannot render the 'Approvata · bloccata' badge or disable the regenerate button for locked locales.
OPTIONAL: add a regression test asserting GET /api/profile/me/identity returns status='locked' for a locked row (e2e test_iter152_live_e2e.py::test_05 already covers this — re-run after fix).
critical_code_review_comments: Cultural directive build_profile_identity_addendum is correctly threaded through translate() via voice_addendum — verified by live ALE output that contains studio-narrative phrasing (& Creative Director, & Directeur Artistique, etc.) rather than literal one-word translations.
Manual override semantics are correct: set_manual writes status='manual', and the orchestrator preserves manual rows on subsequent non-force source upserts.
Editorial wording in InternationalVersionsPanel STATUS_BADGE map is brand-compliant — no 'AI'/'machine'/'tradotto' anywhere; the user-language requirement (Italian) is respected.

Status taxonomy gap: the resolver's `get_identity` function appears to derive `status` solely from the translation row's status column without consulting the new `locked` boolean (migration 081). This is the single defect of this iteration — see action item #1.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (panel renders, editorial wording compliant, testids present)

seed_data_creation: Used the existing admin profile. PATCH source set role_label='Fondatore' (Italian). ALE created en-us/fr-fr/de-de/es-es auto rows. Tests transiently set/unset manual + locked states on en-us; the row was left in status='auto' after restore-ale at the end of the live E2E run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All ITER147 backend endpoints work; the cultural adaptation through REAL ALE/Claude is verified and produces the expected studio-narrative output for en-US/fr-FR/de-DE/es-ES. The ONE defect is GET /api/profile/me/identity not surfacing status='locked' for locked rows — DB persists `locked=true` and POST .../regenerate correctly 409s, but the status mapper in services/profile_identity_resolver.py:get_identity ignores the locked column. After the fix, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter152_live_e2e.py::test_05_lock_blocks_regenerate to confirm.
rca of the issue: Likely root cause: services/profile_identity_resolver.py builds each locale row from editorial_block_translations and copies the `status` column verbatim. Migration 081 added a separate `locked` boolean column, but the builder was not updated to coerce status='locked' when locked=True. The lock_locale function correctly writes locked=true to the DB and regenerate_locale correctly reads it (returning 409), but the read path in get_identity is missing the locked→status coercion.
